entities.summary: Brendan Bell is a Canadian former professional ice hockey defenceman. Bell was selected by the Toronto Maple Leafs in the third round of the 2001 NHL Entry Draft. Bell went on to play with the Phoenix Coyotes, Ottawa Senators and New York Rangers in the NHL, followed by several stints with European teams. He is a businessman and part-time broadcaster in the Ottawa area.
